text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Had Laju Kebangsaan

(Pemberhentian Sementara) (No. 2) 2023.

(2) Perintah ini berkuat kuasa mulai 18 April 2023 hingga 27 April 2023.

Pemberhentian sementara

2. Subperenggan 2(1) Perintah Had Laju Kebangsaan 1989 [P.U. (A) 18/1989]

hendaklah terhenti berkuat kuasa.

Dibuat 11 April 2023

[KKR.PUU.100-1/8/2 Jld.3; PN(PU2)460/Jld. 124]

 LOKE SIEW FOOK

 Menteri Pengangkutan

ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987

NATIONAL SPEED LIMIT (TEMPORARY CESSATION) (NO. 2) ORDER 2023

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 69(1)

of the Road Transport Act 1987 [Act 333], the Minister makes the following order:
